### For educators

You are welcome to teach from the textbook in your courses, in part or in whole, and to share it with your students. The slides, labs, and other teaching materials may also be adapted to your syllabus. Translations or other modified versions of the textbook text need permission. All we ask is that you credit the source and share your improvements to the teaching materials with the community.

### For institutions

If you are considering adopting this curriculum at your university or organization and have questions about licensing, including uses outside non-commercial education such as corporate training, please reach out to [edu@tinyML.org](mailto:edu@tinyML.org).
